html:
A short promotional video in which Le Mans University (Le Mans Université) in western France introduces its acoustics programs. The pitch starts from everyday life: acoustics is all around us, in your daily routine, on the tram, in your music headphones, at the doctor’s office, even on the construction site next to your home.

The university presents itself as home to one of the largest acoustics training centers in France and a leader in the field. Whether students come for a bachelor’s degree, a PhD or the engineering school, the programs are meant to open the door to a wide range of careers: research, industry, health, audio and more.

For readers who know Le Mans mainly for its 24-hour race: the university is also home to LAUM, the Laboratoire d’Acoustique de l’Université du Mans, its acoustics research laboratory.

Video: Le Mans University, shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
